message.reasoning:
We need to fix the test failures. The error: defaultMetaSchemaURI must not be null or empty when constructing JsonSchemaFactory via builder(). So builder() likely requires a default meta-schema URI to be set, maybe via builder(JsonSchemaFactory.getDraftV4())? The API doc says builder without keywords or formats; example shows builder(JsonSchemaFactory.getDraftV4()). So builder() with no args may not set default meta schema, causing exception. So test should use builder(JsonSchemaFactory.getDraftV4()) instead of builder(). Or set defaultMetaSchemaURI via builder method. Since we cannot modify library, we adjust test code to use builder(JsonSchemaFactory.getDraftV4()).

Also builder(JsonSchemaFactory) overload expects a blueprint factory; blueprint must have default meta schema set. In setUp we call JsonSchemaFactory.builder().build() which fails. So we need to change setUp to use builder(JsonSchemaFactory.getDraftV4()).build().

Also other tests using builder() need to change accordingly.

Let's modify test class.

We need to import necessary static methods.

Implementation: replace JsonSchemaFactory.builder() with JsonSchemaFactory.builder(JsonSchemaFactory.getDraftV4()).

Also builderWithBlueprintReturnsBuilder: use JsonSchemaFactory.builder(blueprint) where blueprint built with proper builder.

Also builderMethodIsThreadSafe: each thread uses builder(JsonSchemaFactory.getDraftV4()).

Also builderReturnsNewInstanceOnEachCall, etc.

Also builderReturnsNonNullBuilder test.

Also builtFactoryHasDefaultComponents: after building, check components.

Thus modify code accordingly.

Potential need to import JsonSchemaFactory.getDraftV4()? It's a static method? Actually getDraftV4() likely returns a JsonSchemaFactory instance representing Draft V4. So builder(JsonSchemaFactory.getDraftV4()).build() returns a factory with defaults.

Thus adjust.

Let's produce corrected code.
